title: ICE Keeps Killing People. Can They Be Held to Account? Legal Expert Weighs In
author: John Harwood
content:
It happens again and again: ICE kills someone, and then they're caught in the
same **" cover-your-ass lie"** - that the killing was _self-defense_.

This week, an immigration officer [shot and
killed](https://apnews.com/article/ice-shooting-maine-immigration-
dhs-f26f8c2256aa6f0748582ea4adbb515c) a man in Maine on Monday. Last week, an
officer [shot and killed](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/what-to-know-
about-the-fatal-shooting-of-lorenzo-salgado-araujo-by-ice) a man in Texas.

It brings back into the headlines a key question: how do DHS and ICE seem to
be able to kill civilians with impunity? Law school professor and top civil
rights activist **Maya Wiley** joins **John Harwood** to break it all down.
This was a Substack Live conversation where **Zeteo** subscribers could tune
in live and ask questions.

Watch the **full video above** to hear the two discuss how Congress _should_
respond to the killings, whether the Civil Rights movement is still winning 18
months into Trump's presidency, and Zohran Mamdani vs. Jonathan Greenblatt.
